Body.Content:
A new Work IQ MCP path, /memory/me/coreMemories, gives authorized agents access to a user’s memory profile. This profile enables agents to provide more personalized and relevant assistance. At launch, it includes Custom Instructions, Saved Memories, relevant work account data, and memories derived from chat history. The memory profile will continue to evolve and improve over time.

GA date: December CY2026
